collection.title: VW California T5 2013 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW California T5 2013 - 2015 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this California, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
